title: Inventory Mixer
description: A mod that shuffles your inventory all the time
body:
## Inventory Mixer 

A mod that adds a new layer of challenge by automatically shuffling your inventory at regular intervals.

### Commands:

Enable/Disable: 
```
/im toggle
```

Set Shuffle Interval: 
```
/im interval <ticks>
```

This mod is lightweight, fully compatible with others, and a perfect fit for any modpack.
